main.summary: Periodically removes transfer sessions inactive beyond the configured retention period while preserving active consumers and publication recovery state.

field.name: scopes
field.summary: Creates tenant-scoped service scopes for transfer-session candidate scans and payload deletion.

field.name: coordinator
field.summary: Acquires cross-process item and session mutation locks before cleanup revalidation and deletion.

field.name: dataConfigs
field.summary: Enumerates configured catalogs and resolves authorized tenant storage.

field.name: state
field.summary: Queries stale candidates, publication journals, and dependent transfer sessions.

field.name: options
field.summary: Controls inactivity retention, scan polling, leader retry, startup jitter, and candidate page size.

field.name: leaderLock
field.summary: Provides named PostgreSQL advisory-lock leadership for the cleanup scan.

constructor.name: TransferSessionCleanupAgent
constructor.summary: Initializes the periodic transfer-session cleanup worker and validates its configuration.

method.name: ExecuteAsync
method.summary: Waits a randomized startup delay, acquires named PostgreSQL leadership, retries followers at the configured leader retry interval, scans eligible catalogs using bounded stale-session pages, and retains leadership between scans.
method.param: Signals that the hosted worker must stop.

method.name: ProcessStaleSessionsAsync
method.summary: Captures one fixed activity cutoff and scans authorized catalogs in bounded pages, isolating candidate failures so later candidates continue.
method.param: Current named PostgreSQL leadership lease, verified throughout the scan.

method.name: CleanupCandidateAsync
method.summary: Locks the candidate item and session, reloads catalog-owned state, and deletes tenant payload and metadata only when the session remains stale, has no publication journal, is not publishing, and has no dependent reader session.
method.param: Stale candidate selected by the bounded query.
Fixed inclusive inactivity cutoff for the scan.
Cancellation token for the cleanup attempt.

method.name: GetRandomDelay
method.summary: Returns a uniformly selected delay from zero through the supplied maximum, inclusive.
method.returns: Random delay, or zero when the maximum is zero.
